next_step: POC kickoff for Dedicated with security + infra; deliver reranking eval plan and pricing term sheet
notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS exploring Redwood for relevance/reranking. Primary driver: reduce top-of-funnel noise in in-app search and increase click-through on recommended items. Team has experimented with hybrid BM25 + embedding candidate generation; wants to move reranking to learned transformer-based model for final scoring.

Good fit: workload is reranking-heavy, offline eval sets already available, real-time P95 target modest (~120-200ms for rerank stage). They expect to start on Hosted API for fast iteration then move to Dedicated once latency and cost profile validated.

Key stakeholders: CTO Jenna Oliver (tech lead), Head of Search Product - Rafael Gomez, ML Lead - Priya Desai, VP Engineering - Mark Winters. AE: Aisha Patel. SE: Marco Ruiz.

Quote from call: "We can tolerate a small increase in 1-2% latency if we get a 5-8% lift in MRR from better relevance" — Rafael.

Security posture: SOC2 in place; must confirm KMS integration and audit log retention; plan for EU data residency for some customers.

Pricing sensitivity: mid sensitivity — will commit to Dedicated if unit cost per 1M tokens drops ~35% vs Hosted and SLOs met.

POC ask: 1) rerank endpoint (hosted) with candidate scoring API; 2) offline scoring kit for batch evaluation of 500k query-doc pairs; 3) run A/B against current BM25+learned features.

Docs shared: Pricing deck, security FAQ, sample eval script in Drive. Gmail thread active re: contract params.

pricing_notes: Interested in committed Dedicated pricing if monthly spend >= $12k. Wants a pricing term sheet with delta vs Hosted per 1M token, and optional burst pricing. Ask: sample TCO analysis for 6/12 month horizons.
requirements_summary: Must support reranking endpoint with per-candidate features and custom model plug-in (or profiling of Redwood model outputs). Offline scoring API or export for batch scoring required. SSO + audit logs, KMS for keys, EU residency for a subset of traffic. Can start with hosted for iteration then transition to Dedicated with autoscaling and burst window. P95 latency target for entire search pipeline allowed to be 200-300ms; rerank stage ideally <= 200ms.
